patch.objective: Retry with backoff when a call fails

sources.cite: Tutorials Dojo, 'What's new with the AWS Certified Developer Associate DVA-C03': Development with AWS Services 30%, Security 26%, Testing and Deployment 22%, Troubleshooting and Optimization 22%
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17 (a third-party page, not AWS). It gives the four DVA-C03 domains and weights (matching the course seed), registration from October 27, 2026, the last DVA-C02 exam on November 30, 2026, and general availability on December 1, 2026. The official DVA-C03 guide was not read; the objective wording is the course seed's (to verify).

sources.cite: Amazon DynamoDB Developer Guide, Error handling with DynamoDB
sources.note: Read directly on 2026-11-17. Relevant text: ProvisionedThroughputExceededException, 'Your request rate is too high ... Reduce the frequency of requests using Error retries and exponential backoff', OK to retry; for BatchWriteItem, failed puts come back in UnprocessedItems, 'The most likely cause of a failed read or a failed write is throttling', 'If you retry the batch operation immediately, the underlying read or write requests can still fail due to throttling ... we strongly recommend that you use an exponential backoff algorithm'.
